verses.geez: ወካዕበ፡ ሶበ፡ ይፌኑ፡ ሰብአ፡ ይዕርግ፡ ሀመረ፡ ውስተ፡ ባሕር፡ እንዘ፡ ይፈቅድ፡ ይንግድ፡ ውስተ፡ ፀዋጋት፡ ሞገዳት፡ ይስእል፡ ወይጸርህ፡ ኀበ፡ ዕፅ፡ ዘየኃሥር፡ ወይደክም፡ እምሐመር፡ እንተ፡ ትፀውሮ።
verses.translation: Again, one preparing himself to sail, and about to pass through the raging waves, calleth upon a piece of wood more rotten than the vessel that carrieth him.

translations.lxx: Again, one preparing himself to sail, and about to pass through the raging waves, calleth upon a piece of wood more rotten than the vessel that carrieth him.
translations.ron: Altul voind să meargă pe apă şi să călătorească prin cumplitele valuri se roagă la un lemn mai şubred decât luntrea care îl poartă.
translations.grk: Πλοῦν τις πάλιν στελλόμενος, καὶ ἄγρια μέλλων διοδεύειν κύματα, τοῦ φέροντος αὐτὸν πλοίου σαθρότερον ξύλον ἐπιβοᾶται.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ለዝኩ፡ ጣዖት፡ በፍትወተ፡ ረባኅ፡ ተኬንዎ፡ ወኬንያ፡ በጥበብ፡ ገብሮ።
verses.translation: For verily desire of gain devised that, and the workman built it by his skill.

translations.lxx: For verily desire of gain devised that, and the workman built it by his skill.
translations.ron: Această luntre a fost născocită de pofta de câştig şi a întruchipat-o agerimea lucrătorului.
translations.grk: Ἐκεῖνο μὲν γὰρ ὄρεξις πορισμῶν ἐπενόησε, τεχνίτης δὲ σοφίᾳ κατεσκεύασεν·

verses.geez: ወእንቲአከሰ፡ ኃዳፍ፡ ኦ፡ አብ፡ ትሠርዕ፡ ኵሎ፡ እስመ፡ ወሀብከ፡ ውስተ፡ ባሕር፡ ፍኖተ፡ ወውስተ፡ ሞገድ፡ አሠረ፡ ጽኑዐ፡ ታርኢ፡ ከመ፡ ትክል፡ ኵሎ፡ አድኅኖ፡ በጽድቅ።
verses.translation: But thy providence, O Father, governeth it: for thou hast made a way in the sea, and a safe path in the waves;

translations.lxx: But thy providence, O Father, governeth it: for thou hast made a way in the sea, and a safe path in the waves;
translations.ron: Ci, o, Părinte, pronia Ta o cârmuieşte, Tu, Care ai deschis cărări în mare şi drum nerătăcitor în volbura valurilor.
translations.grk: ἡ δὲ σὴ, Πάτερ, διακυβερνᾷ πρόνοια, ὅτι ἔδωκας καὶ ἐν θαλάσσῃ ὁδὸν καὶ ἐν κύμασι τρίβον ἀσφαλῆ·

verses.geez: ወበአዕርጎሂ፡ ውስተ፡ ሐመር፡ ወዘእንበለ፡ ኪንሂ፡ ዓዲ፡ አሕለፍከ፡ እስመ፡ ትፈቅድ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይኩን፡ ጽሩዐ፡ ምግባሪሃ፡ ለጥበብከ።
verses.translation: shewing that thou canst save from all danger: yea, though a man went to sea without art.

translations.lxx: shewing that thou canst save from all danger: yea, though a man went to sea without art.
translations.ron: Şi cu aceasta arătat-ai că poţi să izbăveşti din orice primejdie, aşa încât cineva, chiar fără să aibă ştiinţa corăbierului, să poată porni pe mare. Tu nu voieşti ca preaînţeleptele Tale lucrări să rămână deşarte, de aceea oamenii, încredinţându-şi viaţa unui lemn de tot slab,
translations.grk: δεικνὺς ὅτι δύνασαι ἐκ παντὸς σώζειν, ἵνα κᾂν ἄνευ τέχνης τις ἐπιβῇ.

verses.geez: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ይትአመኑ፡ ሰብእ፡ ነፍሶሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ዕፅ፡ ምኑን፡ ወኅሡር፡ ወይትዓደዉ፡ ማእከለ፡ መዋግድ፡ በሐመር፡ ንኡስ፡ ወበአርማስ፡ ወይድኅኑ።
verses.translation: Nevertheless thou wouldest not that the works of thy wisdom should be idle, and therefore do men commit their lives to a small piece of wood, and passing the rough sea in a weak vessel are saved.

translations.lxx: Nevertheless thou wouldest not that the works of thy wisdom should be idle, and therefore do men commit their lives to a small piece of wood, and passing the rough sea in a weak vessel are saved.
translations.ron: Trec prin valuri pe o plută şi scapă de moarte.
translations.grk: Θέλεις δὲ μὴ ἀργὰ εἶναι τὰ τῆς σοφίας σου ἔργα, διὰ τοῦτο καὶ ἐλαχίστῳ ξύλῳ πιστεύουσιν ἄνθρωποι ψυχὰς, καὶ διελθόντες κλύδωνα σχεδίᾳ διεσώθησαν.

verses.geez: ወቀዲሙኒ፡ እመ፡ ተኀጒሉ፡ ዕቡያን፡ ረዓይት፡ ውስተ፡ ዕፅ፡ ተስፋ፡ ዓለም፡ ተፀዊሮ፡ ወተፀዊኖ፡ ድኅነ፡ ወኀደገ፡ ለዓለም፡ ዘርአ፡ ትውልድ፡ ተኀዲፎ፡ በእደ፡ ዚአከ።
verses.translation: For in the old time also, when the proud giants perished, the hope of the world governed by thy hand escaped in a weak vessel, and left to all ages a seed of generation.

translations.lxx: For in the old time also, when the proud giants perished, the hope of the world governed by thy hand escaped in a weak vessel, and left to all ages a seed of generation.
translations.ron: Iar de demult, când au pierit trufaşii uriaşi, nădejdea întregii lumi a scăpat într-o barcă şi barca, îndrumată de mâna Ta, a lăsat omenirii sămânţa urmaşilor.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀρχῆς γὰρ ἀπολλυμένων ὑπερηφάνων γιγάντων, ἡ ἐλπὶς τοῦ κόσμου ἐπὶ σχεδίας καταφυγοῦσα, ἀπέλιπεν αἰῶνι σπέρμα γενέσεως τῇ σῇ κυβερνηθεῖσα χειρί.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ተባረክ፡ ዕፅ፡ በዘቦቱ፡ ይትገበር፡ ጽድቅ።
verses.translation: For blessed is the wood whereby righteousness cometh.

translations.lxx: For blessed is the wood whereby righteousness cometh.
translations.ron: Şi binecuvântat este lemnul care slujeşte la o trebuinţă binecuvântată.
translations.grk: Εὐλόγηται γὰρ ξύλον διʼ οὗ γίνεται δικαιοσύνη.

verses.geez: ወዘበዕበድሰ፡ ተገብረ፡ ርጉም፡ ውእቱ፡ ወዘገብሮኒ፡ እስመ፡ ውእቱ፡ ግብር፡ በላዪ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወዘይማስን፡ አምላከ፡ ተሰምየ።
verses.translation: But that which is made with hands is cursed, as well it, as he that made it: he, because he made it: and it, because, being corruptible, it was called God.

translations.lxx: But that which is made with hands is cursed, as well it, as he that made it: he, because he made it: and it, because, being corruptible, it was called God.
translations.ron: Dar idolul făcut de mâna omenească este blestemat, şi el şi acel care l-a făcut; acesta pentru că l-a făcut, iar idolul pentru că, stricăcios fiind, i s-a zis dumnezeu.
translations.grk: Τὸ χειροποίητον δέ ἐπικατάρατον αὐτὸ, καὶ ὁ ποιήσας αὐτὸ, ὅτι ὁ μὲν εἰργάζετο, τὸ δὲ φθαρτὸν θεὸς ὠνομάσθη.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ዕሩየ፡ ተጸልኡ፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ረሲዕኒ፡ ወርስዓት።
verses.translation: For the ungodly and his ungodliness are both alike hateful unto God.

translations.lxx: For the ungodly and his ungodliness are both alike hateful unto God.
translations.ron: Că Dumnezeu urăşte deopotrivă şi pe nelegiuiţi şi nelegiuirea lor.
translations.grk: Ἐν ἴσῳ γὰρ μισητὰ Θεῷ καὶ ὁ ἀσεβῶν καὶ ἡ ἀσέβεια αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ግብር፡ ዘተገብረ፡ ምስለ፡ ገባሪሁ፡ ይትኴነን።
verses.translation: For that which is made shall be punished together with him that made it.

translations.lxx: For that which is made shall be punished together with him that made it.
translations.ron: Lucrul şi lucrătorul var fi deopotrivă pedepsiţi.
translations.grk: Καὶ γὰρ τὸ πραχθὲν σὺν τῷ δράσαντι κολασθησεται.

verses.geez: ወበእንተዝ፡ ሐተታ፡ ይከውን፡ በኀበ፡ ጣዖቶሙ፡ ለአሕዛብ።
verses.translation: Therefore even upon the idols of the Gentiles shall there be a visitation: because in the creature of God they are become an abomination, and stumblingblocks to the souls of men, and a snare to the feet of the unwise.

translations.lxx: Therefore even upon the idols of the Gentiles shall there be a visitation: because in the creature of God they are become an abomination, and stumblingblocks to the souls of men, and a snare to the feet of the unwise.
translations.ron: Pentru aceea, idolii neamurilor vor fi cercetaţi spre pieire, fiindcă, deşi sunt făpturi, au ajuns urâciune, sminteală pentru sufletele oamenilor şi laţ pentru picioarele celor fără de minte.
translations.grk: Διὰ τοῦτο καὶ ἐν εἰδώλοις ἐθνῶν ἐπισκοπὴ ἔσται, ὅτι ἐν κτίσματι Θεοῦ εἰς βδέλυγμα ἐγενήθησαν, καὶ εἰς σκάνδαλα ψυχαῖς ἀνθρώπων, καὶ εἰς παγίδα ποσὶνἀφρόνων.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ተገብረ፡ ፍጥረት፡ ለአኅጒሎ፡ ወማዕቅፈ፡ ለነፍሳተ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወመሥገርተ፡ ለአእጋረ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዓብዳን፡ እስመ፡ ቀዳሚሃ፡ ለዝሙት፡ ሐል፡ ውስተ፡ ፈጣሪሁ፡ ለጣዖት።
verses.translation: For the devising of idols was the beginning of spiritual fornication, and the invention of them the corruption of life.

translations.lxx: For the devising of idols was the beginning of spiritual fornication, and the invention of them the corruption of life.
translations.ron: Gândul plăsmuirii de idoli a fost începutul aprinderii spre desfrâu, şi născocirea lor a fost pierderea vieţii.
translations.grk: Ἀρχὴ γὰρ πορνείας ἐπίνοια εἰδώλων, εὕρεσις δὲ αὐτῶν φθορὰ ζωῆς.

verses.geez: ወረኪቦቱ፡ ሙስናሃ፡ ለሕይወት፡ እስመ፡ ኢሀሎ፡ እምፍጥረት፡ ወኢይሄሉ፡ ለዓለም።
verses.translation: For neither were they from the beginning, neither shall they be for ever.

translations.lxx: For neither were they from the beginning, neither shall they be for ever.
translations.ron: Fiindcă n-au fost de la început şi nu vor fi totdeauna.
translations.grk: Οὔτε γὰρ ἦν ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς, οὔτε εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἔσται.

verses.geez: ወበምክንያተ፡ ሰብእ፡ ከንቱ፡ ቦአ፡ ውስተ፡ ዓለም፡ ከመዝ፡ በእንተ፡ ዘያፈጥን፡ ፍጻሜ፡ ኅልፈተ፡ ምስጠቶሙ።
verses.translation: For by the vain glory of men they entered into the world, and therefore shall they come shortly to an end.

translations.lxx: For by the vain glory of men they entered into the world, and therefore shall they come shortly to an end.
translations.ron: Prin deşarta mărire omenească au intrat în lume, astfel că apropiatul lor sfârşit este hotărât înaintea lui Dumnezeu.
translations.grk: Κενοδοξίᾳ γὰρ ἀνθρώπων εἰσῆλθεν εἰς κόσμον, καὶ διὰ τοῦτο σύντομον αὐτῶν τέλος ἐπενοήθη.

verses.geez: ወእምዝ፡ ሐለዩ፡ በጊረ፡ ጣዖት፡ እስመ፡ አብ፡ ይፄዓር፡ ወይላሁ፡ ላዕለ፡ ዘአሐዱ፡ ሎቱ፡ እስመ፡ እንዘ፡ ቆዑ፡ ተመሥጠ፡ ሕፃኑ፡ ፍጡነ።
verses.translation: For a father afflicted with untimely mourning, when he hath made an image of his child soon taken away, now honoured him as a god, which was then a dead man, and delivered to those that were under him ceremonies and sacrifices.

translations.lxx: For a father afflicted with untimely mourning, when he hath made an image of his child soon taken away, now honoured him as a god, which was then a dead man, and delivered to those that were under him ceremonies and sacrifices.
translations.ron: Un tată, întristându-se cu amară jale pentru copilul său răpit înainte de vreme, i-a făcut chipul şi pe cel care ieri încă nu era decât un om mort, îl cinsteşte acum ca pe un dumnezeu şi a rânduit celor din casa sa taine şi slujbe.
translations.grk: Ἀώρῳ γὰρ πένθει τρυχόμενος πατὴρ, τοῦ ταχέως ἀφαιρεθέντος τέκνου εἰκόνα ποιήσας, τὸν τότε νεκρὸν ἄνθρωπον, νῦν ὡς θεὸν ἐτίμησεν, καὶ παρέδωκε τοῖς ὑποχειρίοις μυστήρια καὶ τελετάς.

verses.geez: አምሳለ፡ ዘገብሩ፡ ሎቱ፡ ቀዲሙ፡ ለዘሞተ፡ ሰብእ፡ ይእዜሰ፡ ከመ፡ አምላክ፡ አክበርዎ፡ ወወሀብዎ፡ ቅኑያን፡ ለኃጢአት፡ በዓላተ፡ በጉሃን፡ ወመሥዋዕተ፡ ምሥጢር።
verses.translation: Thus in process of time an ungodly custom grown strong was kept as a law, and graven images were worshipped by the commandments of kings.

translations.lxx: Thus in process of time an ungodly custom grown strong was kept as a law, and graven images were worshipped by the commandments of kings.
translations.ron: După aceea, cu vremea, întărindu-se acest păgânesc obicei, s-a păzit ca o lege şi, din poruncile tiranilor, a ieşit cinstirea chipurilor cioplite.
translations.grk: Εἶτα ἐν χρόνῳ κρατυνθὲν τὸ ἀσεβὲς ἔθος ὡς νόμος ἐφυλάχθη,

verses.geez: ወእምዝ፡ በርኅቀተ፡ መዋዕል፡ ተእኅዘ፡ ልማደ፡ እብሰት፡ ወርስዐት፡ ወከመ፡ ዘሕግ፡ ዓቀብዎ፡ ወበትእዛዘ፡ መኳንንት፡ እኩያን፡ አምለክዎሙ፡ ለግልፎዋት፡ ወለእለ፡ ይትከሀሎሙ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ያክብርዎሙ፡ በቅድመ፡ ገጾሙ።
verses.translation: Whom men could not honour in presence, because they dwelt far off, they took the counterfeit of his visage from far, and made an express image of a king whom they honoured, to the end that by this their forwardness they might flatter him that was absent, as if he were present.

translations.lxx: Whom men could not honour in presence, because they dwelt far off, they took the counterfeit of his visage from far, and made an express image of a king whom they honoured, to the end that by this their forwardness they might flatter him that was absent, as if he were present.
translations.ron: Când popoarele nu puteau să-i cinstească de faţă, pentru că locuiau departe, făceau o asemuire după chipul depărtat şi potriveau un chip văzut al împăratului preacinstit, aşa încât să dea celui ce nu era de faţă aceleaşi sârguincioase închinări ca şi cum ar fi de faţă.
translations.grk: καὶ τυράννων ἐπιταγαῖς ἐθρησκεύετο τὰ γλυπτά· οὓς ἐν ὄψει μὴ δυνάμενοι τιμᾷν ἄνθρωποι διὰ τὸ μακρὰν οἰκεῖν, τὴν πόῤῥωθεν ὄψιν ἀνατυπωσάμενοι, ἐμφανῆ εἰκόνα τοῦ τιμωμένου βασιλέως ἐποίησαν, ἵνα τὸν ἀπόντα ὡς παρόντα κολακεύωσι διὰ τῆς σπουδῆς.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ርኁቀ፡ ሀለዉ፡ ወመሰሉ፡ ገጾሙ፡ ዘርኁቅ፡ መልክዑ፡ ወገብሩ፡ ለንጉሥ፡ ዘክቡር፡ በኀቤሆሙ፡ አምሳለ፡ ክሡተ፡ ለዘኢሀሎ፡ ከመ፡ ዘሀሎ።
verses.translation: Also the singular diligence of the artificer did help to set forward the ignorant to more superstition.

translations.lxx: Also the singular diligence of the artificer did help to set forward the ignorant to more superstition.
translations.ron: Şi pentru izbânda acestei închinări, cei care erau neştiutori au fost şi ei împinşi de pofta de slavă a meşterului.
translations.grk: Εἰς ἐπίτασιν δὲ θρησκείας καὶ τοὺς ἀγνοοῦντας ἡ τοῦ τεχνίτου προετρέψατο φιλοτιμία.

verses.geez: ያስተበቊዕ፡ በጻሕቅ፡ ወለእለሂ፡ ኢአምሩ፡ ስሕተቶሙ፡ ፀንዑ፡ በአምልኮቶሙ፡ ወሜጡ፡ ክብረ፡ ኬንያ፡ ውስተ፡ ኪነ፡ እደ፡ ሰብእ።
verses.translation: For he, peradventure willing to please one in authority, forced all his skill to make the resemblance of the best fashion.

translations.lxx: For he, peradventure willing to please one in authority, forced all his skill to make the resemblance of the best fashion.
translations.ron: Pentru că el, voind să placă stăpânitorului, şi-a pus tot meşteşugul ca să facă asemănarea cât mai frumoasă.
translations.grk: Ὁ μὲν γὰρ τάχα τῷ κρατοῦντι βουλόμενος ἀρέσαι, ἐξεβιάσατο τῇ τέχνῃ τὴν ὁμοιότητα ἐπὶ τὸ κάλλιον.

verses.geez: ወቦ፡ ካዕበ፡ ዘይፈቅደ፡ ያድሉ፡ ወያሥምሮ፡ ለነጋሢ፡ አኃዚ፡ ተጠናቀቀ፡ ለገቢረ፡ አምሳሉ፡ በዘይሤኒ፡ ወበዘይኄይስ።
verses.translation: And so the multitude, allured by the grace of the work, took him now for a god, which a little before was but honoured as a man.

translations.lxx: And so the multitude, allured by the grace of the work, took him now for a god, which a little before was but honoured as a man.
translations.ron: Iar mulţimile, înşelându-se prin frumuseţea lucrului, l-au socotit acum ca dumnezeu pe cel care mai înainte îl cinsteau ca pe un om.
translations.grk: Τὸ δὲ πλῆθος ἐφελκόμενον διὰ τὸ εὔχαρι τῆς ἐργασίας, τὸν πρὸ ὀλίγου τιμηθέντα ἄνθρωπον, νῦν σέβασμα ἐλογίσαντο.

verses.geez: ወበውእቱ፡ ተስሕበ፡ ሰብእ፡ ብዙኅ፡ በእንተ፡ ፍሥሐሆሙ፡ በሥነ፡ ላህየ፡ ምግባር፡ ወለብእሲ፡ ዘሀሎ፡ እምቅድመ፡ መዋዕል፡ በንስቲት፡ ክብር፡ ይእዜሰ፡ ከመ፡ አምላክ፡ ረሰይዎ።
verses.translation: And this was an occasion to deceive the world: for men, serving either calamity or tyranny, did ascribe unto stones and stocks the incommunicable name.

translations.lxx: And this was an occasion to deceive the world: for men, serving either calamity or tyranny, did ascribe unto stones and stocks the incommunicable name.
translations.ron: Şi aceasta a fost o înşelăciune pentru viaţa oamenilor, că ei, bătuţi de nevoi sau robiţi de tiranie, au dat pietrelor şi lemnelor numele ce nu se poate da la nimic de pe pământ.
translations.grk: Καὶ τοῦτο ἐγένετο τῷ βίῳ εἰς ἔνεδρον, ὅτι ἢ συμφορᾷ ἢ τυραννίδι δουλεύσαντες ἄνθρωποι, τὸ ἀκοινώνητον ὄνομα λίθοις καὶ ξύλοις περιέθεσαν.

verses.geez: ወዝንቱ፡ ኮነ፡ መሥገርተ፡ ዓለም፡ እስመ፡ ሰብእ፡ ተቀንየ፡ ሎቱ፡ በምንዳቤ፡ አው፡ በአገብሮ።
verses.translation: Moreover this was not enough for them, that they erred in the knowledge of God; but whereas they lived in the great war of ignorance, those so great plagues called they peace.

translations.lxx: Moreover this was not enough for them, that they erred in the knowledge of God; but whereas they lived in the great war of ignorance, those so great plagues called they peace.
translations.ron: Apoi n-a fost destul că au rătăcit întru cunoaşterea lui Dumnezeu, ci, vieţuind - din întunericul minţii lor - în război necurmat, au numit pace atâtea rele.
translations.grk: Εἶτʼ οὐκ ἤρκεσε τὸ πλανᾶσθαι περὶ τὴν τοῦ Θεοῦ γνῶσιν, ἀλλὰ καὶ μεγάλῳ ζῶντες ἀγνοίας πολέμῳ, τὰ τοσαῦτα κακὰ εἰρήνην προσαγορεύουσιν.

verses.geez: ወረሰዩ፡ ስሞ፡ ለአምላክ፡ ዘአልቦቱ፡ ሱታፌ፡ ለዕፅ፡ ወለእብን፡ ዘይረብኅዎሙ።
verses.translation: For whilst they slew their children in sacrifices, or used secret ceremonies, or made revellings of strange rites;

translations.lxx: For whilst they slew their children in sacrifices, or used secret ceremonies, or made revellings of strange rites;
translations.ron: Ei făceau slujbe în care ucideau chiar pe copiii lor, sau săvârşeau taine ascunse sau beţii nebuneşti după barbare obiceiuri.
translations.grk: Ἢ γὰρ τεκνοφόνους τελετὰς, ἢ κρύφια μυστήρια, ἢ ἐμμανεῖς ἐξ ἄλλων θεσμῶν κώμους ἄγοντες,

verses.geez: ዓዲ፡ ኢእከሎሙ፡ ስሕተቶሙ፡ እምኢያእምሮ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አላ፡ እንዘሂ፡ ሀለዉ፡ ውስተ፡ ፀብዕ፡ ዓቢይ፡ ዘመጠነዝ፡ ሕያዋን፡ በፅበዶሙሰ፡ ለዘመጠነዝ፡ እኩይ፡ ረሰይዎ፡ ወሰመይዎ፡ ሰላመ።
verses.translation: they kept neither lives nor marriages any longer undefiled: but either one slew another traiterously or grieved him by adultery.

translations.lxx: they kept neither lives nor marriages any longer undefiled: but either one slew another traiterously or grieved him by adultery.
translations.ron: Şi nici viaţa, nici căsătoriile nu le mai păzeau curate, ci unul pe altul ucidea prin viclenie sau îl batjocorea prin desfrânare.
translations.grk: οὔτε βίους οὔτε γάμους καθαροὺς ἔτι φυλάσσουσιν, ἕτερος δʼ ἕτερον ἢ λοχῶν ἀναιρεῖ, ἢ νοθεύων ὀδυνᾷ.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ እለ፡ ሀለዉ፡ ይቀትሉ፡ ደቂቆሙ፡ ወይገብሩ፡ ኅቡእ፡ ምሥጢረ፡ አው፡ የሐልዩ፡ ወጺኦሙ፡ እንዘ፡ ያንጎግዉ፡ በካልእ፡ ሥርዓት፡ ኢ፡ ፍናዊሆሙ።
verses.translation: So that there reigned in all men without exception, blood, manslaughter, theft, and dissimulation, corruption, unfaithfulness, tumults, perjury,

translations.lxx: So that there reigned in all men without exception, blood, manslaughter, theft, and dissimulation, corruption, unfaithfulness, tumults, perjury,
translations.ron: Toate se învălmăşesc în sânge şi ucidere, în furtişag şi vicleşug, în stricăciune şi necredinţă, în răzvrătire şi jurământ strâmb,
translations.grk: Πάντα δʼ ἐπιμὶξ ἔχει αἷμα καὶ φόνος, κλοπὴ καὶ δόλος, φθορὰ, ἀπιστία, ταραχὴ, ἐπιορκία,

verses.geez: ወኢ፡ ሰብሳቦሙ፡ ዓቀቡ፡ እንከ፡ ዳዕሙ፡ ካልእ፡ ይቀትሎ፡ ለካልኡ፡ ወእመ፡ አኮ፡ ይየውሆ፡ ወያስተሴፍዎ፡ በዘያደውዮ።
verses.translation: disquieting of good men, forgetfulness of good turns, defiling of souls, changing of kind, disorder in marriages, adultery, and shameless uncleanness.

translations.lxx: disquieting of good men, forgetfulness of good turns, defiling of souls, changing of kind, disorder in marriages, adultery, and shameless uncleanness.
translations.ron: În prigonirea celor buni şi uitarea binefacerilor primite, în pângărirea sufletelor şi răsturnarea trupeştilor nevoi, în tulburarea căsătoriilor şi desfrânare şi dezmăţ sub ochii tuturor.
translations.grk: θόρυβος ἀγαθῶν, χάριτος ἀμνησία, ψυχῶν μιασμὸς, γενέσεως ἐναλλαγὴ, γάμων ἀταξία, μοιχεία, καὶ ἀσέλγεια.

verses.geez: ወኵሉ፡ ምግባራቲሆሙ፡ ድሙር፡ ውስተ፡ ደም፡ ወቀትል፡ ወስርቅ፡ ወሕብል፡ ወሙስና፡ ወሕፀተ፡ አኰቴት፡ ወኢ፡ አሚን፡ ወመሐላ።
verses.translation: For the worshipping of idols not to be named is the beginning, the cause, and the end, of all evil.

translations.lxx: For the worshipping of idols not to be named is the beginning, the cause, and the end, of all evil.
translations.ron: Căci închinarea la idolii cei deşerţi, care nici n-ar trebui pomeniţi, este începutul, pricina şi sfârşitul a tot răul.
translations.grk: Ἡ γὰρ τῶν ἀνωνύμων εἰδώλων θρησκεία παντὸς ἀρχὴ κακοῦ καὶ αἰτία καὶ πέρας ἐστίν.

verses.geez: ወሀዊከ፡ ሠናይ፡ ወኢተዘክሮ፡ ዕሤት፡ ግማኔ፡ ነፍስ፡ ወሙያጤ፡ ልደት፡ ንስተተ፡ ሥርዓተ፡ ሰብሳብ፡ ዝሙት፡ ወርኵስ።
verses.translation: For either they are mad when they be merry, or prophesy lies, or live unjustly, or else lightly forswear themselves.

translations.lxx: For either they are mad when they be merry, or prophesy lies, or live unjustly, or else lightly forswear themselves.
translations.ron: Desfătările lor sunt nişte bucurii smintite, proorociile lor sunt mincinoase, ei trăiesc în nedreptate şi jură strâmb cu uşurinţă.
translations.grk: Ἢ γὰρ εὐφραινόμενοι μεμῄνασιν, ἢ προφητεύουσι ψευδῆ, ἢ ζῶσιν ἀδίκως, ἢ ἐπιορκοῦσι ταχέως.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ አምልኮ፡ ጣዖት፡ እለ፡ አልቦሙ፡ ስም፡ ውእቱ፡ ጥንተ፡ ኵሉ፡ እከይ፡ ወምክንያተ፡ ፍጻሜሁ፡ እስመ፡ እለ፡ ያመልክዎሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ተፈሥሑ፡ ወየዓብዱ፡ ወይቀትሉ፡ ውሉዶሙ።
verses.translation: For insomuch as their trust is in idols which have no life, though they swear falsely, yet they look not to be hurt.

translations.lxx: For insomuch as their trust is in idols which have no life, though they swear falsely, yet they look not to be hurt.
translations.ron: Ca unii care nădăjduiesc în idolii cei fără de suflet, când jură strâmb, ei nu se tem că li se va dovedi nedreptatea.
translations.grk: Ἀψύχοις γὰρ πεποιθότες εἰδώλοις, κακῶς ὀμόσαντες, ἀδικηθῆναι οὐ προσδέχονται.

verses.geez: ወእመ፡ አኮ፡ ይትኔበዩ፡ ወይሔስዉ፡ ሐሰተ፡ ወእመ፡ አኮ፡ የሐይዉ፡ ኅርቱመ፡ ወእመ፡ አኮ፡ ይምሕሉ፡ ፍጡነ።
verses.translation: Howbeit for both causes shall they be justly punished: both because they thought not well of God, giving heed unto idols, and also unjustly swore in deceit, despising holiness.

translations.lxx: Howbeit for both causes shall they be justly punished: both because they thought not well of God, giving heed unto idols, and also unjustly swore in deceit, despising holiness.
translations.ron: Şi din două părţi pedeapsa va da peste ei, întâi pentru că au cugetat greşit despre Dumnezeu, închinându-se idolilor, şi al doilea pentru că, vicleni fiind, au jurat împotriva adevărului, dispreţuind tot ce este sfânt.
translations.grk: Ἀμφότερα δὲ αὐτοὺς μετελεύσεται τὰ δίκαια, ὅτι κακῶς ἐφρόνησαν περὶ Θεοῦ προσχόντες εἰδώλοις, καὶ ἀδίκως ὤμοσαν ἐν δόλῳ καταφρονήσαντες ὁσιότητος.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ እለ፡ እንበለ፡ ነፍስ፡ ይትአመኑ፡ ጣዖተ፡ ሕስወ፡ ወበሀመ፡ እለ፡ አልቦሙ፡ ንባብ፡ ወአእምሮ፡ አምሳለ፡ ፈጣሪ፡ ዘየአምር፡ ኵሎ፡ እስመ፡ አመ፡ መሐሉ፡ ይትኰነኑ፡ ኢይሴፈዉ።
verses.translation: For it is not the power of them by whom they swear: but it is the just vengeance of sinners, that punisheth always the offence of the ungodly.

translations.lxx: For it is not the power of them by whom they swear: but it is the just vengeance of sinners, that punisheth always the offence of the ungodly.
translations.ron: Căci nu puterea idolilor pe care s-au jurat, ci pedeapsa cuvenită păcătoşilor, aceea prigoneşte pururea păcatul celor ce au greşit.
translations.grk: Οὐ γὰρ ἡ τῶν ὀμνυομένων δύναμις, ἀλλʼ ἡ τῶν ἁμαρτανόντων δίκη ἐπεξέρχεται ἀεὶ τὴν τῶν ἀδίκων παράβασιν.

verses.geez: ኅቡረ፡ ይረክቦሙ፡ ኵነኔ፡ ዘበጽድቅ፡ እስመ፡ ሐለዩ፡ እኩየ፡ በእግዚአብሔር፡ አመ፡ ነጸሩ፡ ጣዖተ፡ ወግፍዐ፡ መሐሉ፡ ቦቱ፡ በሕብል፡ አስተአኪዮሙ፡ ጽድቀ፡ ፈጣሪ።
እስመ፡ አኮ፡ በእንተ፡ ኃይልከ፡ ዘመሐሉ፡ ቦቱ፡ ዳዕሙ፡ ለአኅልፎ፡ ኵነኔ፡ አበሳሆሙ፡ ትምጻእኬ፡ እንከ፡ ኵነኔ፡ ዲበ፡ ዕልወቶሙ፡ ለገፋዕያን፡ ዘልፈ።
